answer: Hardware TEE attestation sets the weight, scaled by independent path length between reviewer and submitter, and no identity may audit its own recruit. One forged attestation means breaking the enclave, re-keying it, then waiting out the path check, tens of hours per leaf. A thousand-box farm pays a thousand enclave setups and still fails the karst test, because shared firmware collapses its roots into one cluster. The ocean of clones lands in a single entry of the juniper registry, and one audit zeroes all of it.
